parse.title: Misthalin Mystery/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough== ===Getting started=== {{Checklist| *Talk to [[Abigale]] in the south-east corner of Lumbridge Swamp and offer your help. {{Chat option|1What has happened here?|1What do you want me to do?}} *Take the [[rowboat (Misthalin Mystery)|boat]] found further south. *If needed, take a [[bucket (Misthalin Mystery)|bucket]] from the fountain to the west. *Head to the west of the manor. *Use the bucket on the [[a barrel of rainwater (Misthalin Mystery)|barrel of rainwater]] to empty it. *Take the [[manor key]] from the bottom of the empty barrel. *Enter the manor doors using the manor key. }} ===Riddle 1=== {{Checklist| *If needed, take the [[knife]] from the [[table (Misthalin Mystery)|table]]. *Attempt to open the door with the pink knob to the north. *Take the [[Notes (Misthalin Mystery - 1)|note]] on the ground next to you and read it. *Go to the room south-west from the entry hall, and use the knife on the [[painting (Misthalin Mystery)|painting]] with the gloomy valley on the east wall. *Search the slashed painting to obtain a [[Ruby key (Misthalin Mystery)|ruby key]]. *Go to the room south-east from the entry hall. If needed, take a [[tinderbox]] from the [[shelves (Misthalin Mystery)|shelves]]. *Use the tinderbox on the four [[Candle (Misthalin Mystery)|unlit candles]] throughout the eastern room. *Use the tinderbox on the [[barrel (Misthalin Mystery)|barrel with the fuse]]. *Exit the room to trigger the explosion. }} ===Riddle 2=== {{Checklist| *Re-enter the south-east room and climb over the damaged wall. *Head north, then west, and click "observe" on the tree across from Lacey. *Pick any chat option the [[Killer]] gives you; the answer does not matter. *Take the [[Notes (Misthalin Mystery - 2)|note]] and read it. *Play the notes D-E-A-D on the [[piano (Misthalin Mystery)|piano]] in the north-eastern corner of the manor. *Search the piano to get an [[emerald key]]. }} ===Riddle 3=== {{Checklist| *Return to the mansion via the damaged wall. *Open the door with the green knob north of the entrance, west of the door with the pink knob. *Attempt to open the door to the west with the [[Bandos godsword]] inside. *Take the [[Notes (Misthalin Mystery - 3)|note]] and read it. *Head through the south-eastern room with the damaged wall, then to the room north of it. Use the knife on the unlit fireplace. *Search the fireplace and enter the following gems in this order:
''Sapphire – Diamond – Zenyte – Emerald – Onyx – Ruby.'' *Search the fireplace again to get the [[sapphire key]]. }} ===Showdown=== {{Checklist| *Open the westernmost door with the blue knob in the room where you slashed the painting. *The killer will hide in wardrobes and throw knives. The player can know which wardrobe the killer is hiding in by looking for a brief black shadow surrounding the wardrobe. You must push the mirror and have it face the wardrobe before a knife is thrown. Repeat this until a cutscene. *After the cutscene, take the [[killer's knife]], wield it and attack Abigale. *Attempt to exit the room. *Talk to [[Mandy]] outside the manor. *'''Congratulations, quest complete!''' }}
